rationale: Democrats flip US Senate in 2026 midterms, widely seen as rebuke to Trump's Republican Party; multiple Democratic victories including first black Georgia governor and South Carolina Democratic senator in decades represent major political shift.

top_events.title: Democratic Party flips US Senate in 2026 midterm elections
top_events.label: Democrats flip US Senate in midterms
top_events.summary: Democrats win Senate control in 2026 midterms, widely seen as rebuke to Trump's Republican Party which won chamber in 2024. Major shift in legislative power and policy direction.

top_events.title: Keisha Lance Bottoms becomes Georgia's first black governor
top_events.label: Georgia elects first black governor Bottoms
top_events.summary: Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms elected Georgia's first black governor. Historic milestone in key swing state with national implications.

top_events.title: South Carolina elects Democratic senator for first time in almost three decades
top_events.label: South Carolina elects Democratic senator first time
top_events.summary: Annie Andrews defeats Trump-backed Darline Graham, first Democratic senator in South Carolina in almost 30 years. Significant shift in traditionally Republican state.
